name: Soul Feast #84: Scarlett Lewis – How to Choose Love While You’re Still in Pain: Scarlett Lewis- Gary Zukav’s Personal Experiences
short-description: Your journey to Authentic Power begins here.
blog-single-description: Your journey to Authentic Power begins here.
blog-rich-text:

In this deeply moving continuation, Gary Zukav and Scarlett Lewis – founder of the Choose Love Movement – explore the interior landscape of Authentic Power: what it truly means to choose love not just as a feeling, but as a conscious act of will in the face of grief, fear, and loss. Together, they trace the path from forgiveness to compassion, and from compassion to personal transformation.

At the center of their exchange is a truth both hard-won and universal: that the frightened parts of our personalities – anger, judgment, resentment, and righteousness – are not enemies to defeat but opportunities for deeper awareness. Scarlett shares how forgiving the individual responsible for the death of her son, Jesse, was not an act of denial, but of liberation – and how that conscious choice led her to feel genuine compassion, and ultimately, love.

Gary illuminates what makes this possible: 

A new level of consciousness allows us to see that we are not our frightened parts. We can observe them, choose not to be controlled by them, and act from our loving parts – even while fear is still present. 

That is the exact moment Authentic Power is created.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

  • (03:57) — Gary reflects on why he invited Scarlett back: her response to Jesse’s transition demonstrates what it looks like to face the frightened parts of the personality and choose love over judgment.
  • (14:36) — Scarlett shares the internal process of forgiveness—releasing the charge of an event to move from the pain of the personality into the compassion and love of the Soul.
  • (19:55) — Gary and Scarlett explore the paradox of Authentic Power: the tools of Emotional Awareness and Responsible Choice are simple, but applying them while fear is active is the most demanding work in the Earth School.
  • (22:12) — Gary describes the exact moment Authentic Power is created: when you choose to act from a loving part of your personality while simultaneously experiencing the sensations of a frightened part.
  • (31:55) — Scarlett reflects on approaching painful experiences as a Soul curriculum—turning toward difficulty with curiosity so that it refines, rather than defines, your life.
  • (38:17) — Scarlett invites listeners to visit ChooseLoveMovement.org to access tools for the next generation, helping children learn the skills of Authentic Power so they meet the world with love instead of fear.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

Think of a moment when you felt the pull of a frightened part of your personality – anger, resentment, or the urge to be against something rather than for something. Now ask yourself: what was the loving intention beneath it that you couldn’t yet access? The next time a frightened part becomes active, pause before you act or speak. Ask: what would it look like to respond from the part of me that loves? You don’t have to feel love first. You only have to choose it.

name: Soul Feast #83: Choosing Love Over Revenge: From Sandy Hook to 18,000 Schools – Gary Zukav’s Personal Experiences
short-description: Your journey to Authentic Power begins here.

blog-rich-text:

In this profound co-creation, Gary Zukav welcomes his first-ever Deepcast guest: Scarlett Lewis, founder of the Choose Love Movement – a global nonprofit now reaching nearly 18,000 schools across 132 countries.

Scarlett shares the internal dynamics behind the movement, born from the experience of her six-year-old son Jesse’s return home on December 14th, 2012. Rather than surrender to the frightened parts of her personality that sought grief or revenge, she found her purpose in three words Jesse had written on the family’s kitchen chalkboard shortly before his transition: Nurturing, Healing, Love.

At the heart of Choose Love is a simple but profound truth: hurt people hurt people. Scarlett recognized through direct experience that if the shooter had been able to give and receive nurturing, healing love, the tragedy would never have occurred. That awareness did not produce blame – it produced a mission of the heart.

Gary reflects on Scarlett’s journey through the lens of the New Consciousness: what the personality calls a tragedy, the Soul recognizes as an opportunity for evolution – 

One that has already changed millions of lives and made clear that love is not a feeling to wait for, but a Responsible Choice available in every moment.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

  • (02:06) — The Choose Love Movement: Scarlett introduces the intentional vessel of her global nonprofit and the experience that gave birth to it. She shares how Jesse’s final chalkboard message – Nurturing, Healing, Love – became her life’s mission and the foundation for creating Authentic Power in the next generation.
  • (07:55) — Refined, Not Defined: Scarlett describes her Responsible Choice following the Sandy Hook transition: the decision to not be defined by the frightened parts of the personality or grief. She chose joy and modeled for her surviving son what it means to be for love rather than against fear.
  • (11:06) — A Miracle, Not a Tragedy: Gary reframes the events through the lens of multisensory perception. What the five-sensory personality labels a tragedy, the Soul recognizes as a miracle of awakening – one that has seeded a global movement and revealed the reality that love is an available choice in every Choice Moment™.
  • (19:15) — Global Dissemination: From a farmhouse in Sandy Hook to nearly 18,000 schools, Scarlett discusses the Soul’s intention for this work. The movement’s reach culminated in “Choose Love” appearing in NFL end zones and on helmets at the Super Bowl – a beautiful sign of our collective awakening.
  • (25:22) — The Gift of Attention: Scarlett shares the experience of sitting with school shooters and asking the question the intellect often avoids: What needs were not met? Their answer – that they didn’t feel seen – leads Gary and Scarlett to explore the Reverence required to see the holiness in every Soul we encounter.
  • (29:50) — There Is No “Out There”: Understanding the multisensory reality that there is no separation between the inner and outer worlds. Every choice to move from fear to love ripples across the collective. As Scarlett notes, the change we seek in the Earth School must first be anchored within our own hearts.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

Think of someone you recently pulled back from – a stranger, a colleague, someone in the news. What story did your mind tell about them? Now consider: what if that person simply didn’t feel seen? The next time you feel yourself contracting, pause and ask: Can I look for the light in this person right now? You don’t have to understand them or agree with them. Just choose – for one moment – to see them.

name: Soul Snack #82: The Reason Jealousy Keeps Coming Back
short-description: Your emotions are messages from your soul.
blog-single-description: Your emotions are messages from your soul.
blog-rich-text:
Your emotions are messages from your soul. Learn How to Tune In, Listen HERE

A new multisensory consciousness is transforming humanity, and with it comes an invitation to look honestly at the parts of ourselves we have long avoided – or justified. In this Soul Snack, Gary Zukav and Linda Francis explore jealousy: what it feels like in the body, how it shapes our behavior, and what it truly means to choose love when a frightened part of the personality is active.

Linda Francis opens with a candid admission – she was a deeply jealous person for most of her life, and for a long time, she didn’t fully recognize it. 

When she did, her first instinct was to believe she had a right to feel that way – that the circumstances justified her reaction. But through her Spiritual Partnership with Gary, Linda came to understand a fundamental truth: changing the people and situations around her would never change the internal dynamics generating her pain.

The shift occurred when Linda stopped “acting out” her jealousy – pushing away, judging, or separating – and made the Responsible Choice to feel the sensation instead. By naming the fear to Gary and staying present with the physical sensations in her energy processing centers, she empowered her loving parts. Over time, that frightened part of her personality lost its grip, allowing for a deeper alignment with her Soul.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Snack:

  • (00:43) — Linda on living with unrecognized jealousy: Linda shares how deeply jealousy ran through her life – and how long she believed the circumstances around her were responsible for it.
  • (01:41) — The moment the work began: Once Linda could no longer look outside herself for answers, she turned inward – naming the feelings in her body and telling Gary the truth of what she was experiencing.
  • (02:40) — What she did instead of acting out: Rather than separating from Gary or blaming him, Linda chose to feel the jealousy fully – noticing thoughts and body sensations – without letting them direct her actions.
  • (03:35) — How repetition created real change: By returning to this practice each time jealousy arose, Linda gradually gained power over that part of her personality, until what was once constant now appears only rarely.
  • (04:00) — The only thing that actually worked: Changing herself – not the people or circumstances around her – was the only thing that helped her to choose to act from a loving part of her personality, and the same applies to every frightened part of the personality rooted in fear.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

This week, when jealousy arises  -whether it shows up as a tightness in the chest, a sudden urge to pull away, or a thought that someone else is more than you – pause before acting on it. Ask yourself: Where do I feel this in my body? What story is it telling me? And what would it look like to feel this fully without letting it decide what I do next? Each time you choose to feel rather than react, you take one more step toward Authentic Power.

A new multisensory consciousness is transforming humanity, and with it comes a deeper capacity for connection – one that begins not with the world around us, but within ourselves. In this Soul Snack, Gary Zukav and Linda Francis explore the experience of compassion: what it feels like when it arises naturally, and what it means to cultivate it deliberately through the practice of Authentic Power.

Linda Francis opens by reflecting on how grateful she feels whenever compassion moves through her – and how it always leads back to love. She invites Gary to share his own experience, and he describes compassion arising most reliably in moments of judgment. 

When he notices himself criticizing or pulling away from someone, he makes the Responsible Choice to remember that they are a Soul in a frightened part of their personality, and in pain.

In that remembering, the desire to connect overtakes the impulse to judge.

The Authentic Power Guidelines define compassion as the practice of noticing that other people are Souls, just like us, who sometimes have frightened parts of their personalities active – and that remembering this is often enough to bring us back to the frequency of Love.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Snack:

  • (00:43) — Linda reflects on the feeling of compassion: Linda shares her gratitude for the moments when compassion arises naturally – and how it always connects back to love.
  • (01:01) — Gary on when compassion emerges most clearly: For Gary, compassion tends to surface in moments of judgment – when he notices himself criticizing someone and remembers they are a soul in pain.
  • (01:38) — How remembering shifts the experience: When Gary recognizes that someone is in a frightened part of their personality, the impulse to judge loses its pull, and the desire to connect takes its place.
  • (02:57) — The Authentic Power definition of compassion: The guidelines offer a clear and actionable understanding: compassion is remembering that other people are souls like us, who sometimes have frightened parts active – a tool that can interrupt judgment and return us to love.
  • (03:39) — The progression of practice: Gary describes the natural arc of creating Authentic Power – from I can do this to this is who I am – where compassion becomes instinctive rather than intentional.
  • (04:24) — Linda on the role of intention: Linda observes that Gary’s consistency with compassion flows from his clear intention to create Authentic Power  – and Gary affirms that he renews that intention every morning, every evening, and many times in between.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

This week, when judgment arises toward someone in your life, pause before acting on it. Ask yourself: Is this person in a frightened part of their personality? Are they in pain? Let that question soften the distance. Each time you choose to remember that the person in front of you is a soul, just like you, you take one more step toward Authentic Power.

name: Soul Feast #81: Why You Are the Universe – Gary Zukav’s Personal Experiences
short-description: Discover a new way of seeing and experiencing the world.
blog-single-description: Discover a new way of seeing and experiencing the world.
blog-rich-text:
Discover a new way of seeing and experiencing the world. Start your journey to multisensory perception HERE

In this Soul Feast, Gary Zukav brings his personal series to its most expansive destination yet: the Universe itself. Drawing on four years of profound transformation following Linda Francis’s Soul transition to non-physical reality, and the wisdom accumulated through his encounters with non-physical teachers, Jesus, Buddha, and Krishna:

Gary arrives at the insight anchoring every Soul Feast in this series – the Universe is not something you observe. It is something you are.

He revisits the final chapter of The Dancing Wu Li Masters and finds that words he chose a half-century ago – before his personality could fully grasp them – now describe precisely what he is living. Gary traces the arc of human consciousness from five-sensory perception – where only the physical world is real – to the multisensory awareness now emerging across the planet. Genesis taught him this transformation is happening within three generations, with roughly four billion Souls now carrying the new consciousness.

The answer Gary arrives at is simple and total: the Universe is Love, Authentic Power is Love, and the only meaningful work left in the Earth School is to expand awareness of that love – by challenging the frightened parts of your personality and making the Responsible Choice, moment by moment, to let love drive.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

  • (00:00) — An Unprecedented Transformation: Gary names the shift reshaping human history and frames the central choice every listener faces: gratitude, patience, and awe, or anger, worry, and despair.
  • (01:22) — The Arc of This Series: Gary reflects on the journey this series has traced – from Linda’s transition and his encounter with Genesis, to Jesus, Buddha, and Krishna – and explains why the Universe is the destination they were always moving toward.
  • (09:00) — The Dancing Wu Li Masters Closes the Circle: Gary returns to the final chapter of his first book, written a half-century ago while “sleepwalking,” and discovers that the words he chose then now describe exactly what he is living.
  • (12:16) — The Universe Is All That Is: Drawing on Genesis’s teaching that Gary is the Universe – not an observer of it – Gary explores what it means that the Universe is not a container for love. It is love itself.
  • (16:26) — Enjoy Yourself. All Is Perfect.: For 40 years, Genesis ended every session with the same words – enjoy yourself, all is perfect – and Gary only now understands it was never a farewell. It was an instruction. Joy is the revealer of love: you cannot experience both at the same time.
  • (20:31) — Changing Yourself Changes the World: The old consciousness sees an uncrossable barrier between inner and outer. The new sees none. As you create authentic power within, the world transforms with you.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

Think of the last time you tried to change something outside of yourself and found yourself spinning your wheels. What was driving you in that moment –  love or fear? Gary invites you to try a different experiment today: instead of reaching outward, pause and ask the question Genesis asked him for forty years – can I enjoy myself here? All is perfect. Not as a platitude, but as a practice.

name: Soul Snack #80: The Hidden Message Inside Every Emotion You’ve Been Ignoring
short-description: Your emotions are messages from your soul.
blog-single-description: Your emotions are messages from your soul.
blog-rich-text:
Your emotions are messages from your soul. Learn How to Tune In and Listen HERE

A new multisensory consciousness is transforming humanity, and with it comes a more intimate understanding of our internal landscape. In this Soul Snack, Gary Zukav responds to a listener question about Emotional Awareness – specifically whether labeling emotions is a useful part of the inner journey. With characteristic depth, he explains that emotions do not exist in the realm of the intellect, and that true awareness requires something far more personal than a label.

Gary distinguishes between the intellect, which is always comparative and judgmental, and the physical body, which is the true gateway to emotional experience. Emotions, he explains, are messengers from the Soul – continuously signaling whether you are about to act from a frightened part of your personality or a loving part. Dismissing these messages means forfeiting the very spiritual evolution they are offering.

The most direct path is not intellectualization, but sensation – feeling emotions intimately within your energy processing centers, where the real patterns of your Authentic Power are revealed.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Snack:

  • (00:42) — A listener asks whether labeling emotions has a place in Emotional Awareness: Janet raises the inquiry of whether naming what we feel is a meaningful part of the inner journey Gary teaches.
  • (00:59) — Why emotions cannot be reached through the intellect: Labels and analysis belong to the realm of thought – emotions exist in an entirely different domain, accessible only through the physical body and your energy processing centers.
  • (01:30) — How your thoughts reveal which part of your personality is active: Judgmental or comparative thinking is a dependable signal that a frightened part of the personality is in control of your awareness.
  • (02:23) — Emotions as the force field of the Soul: Our emotions are not obstacles but messengers – continuously guiding us toward love or alerting us to fear. Making the Responsible Choice based on those messages is where Authentic Power begins.
  • (04:48) — The shift from external power to Authentic Power: Gary draws the defining distinction between chasing external circumstances to find relief and turning inward to face what has been activated – the only path that creates lasting spiritual evolution.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

This week, when a strong emotion arises, resist the urge to name it or trace it back to someone else. Instead, pause and bring your attention into your body. Where do you feel it? Sit with those sensations without judgment and ask yourself: Is this a messenger from my soul? Is it pointing me toward fear or toward love? Each time you choose to feel rather than analyze, you take one step closer to Authentic Power.

name: Soul Feast #80: Who’s Driving Your Chariot? Krishna & The Great Battle – Gary Zukav’s Personal Experiences
short-description: Discover a new way of seeing and experiencing the world.
blog-single-description: Discover a new way of seeing and experiencing the world.
blog-rich-text:
Discover a new way of seeing and experiencing the world. Start your journey to multisensory perception HERE

In this Soul Feast, Gary Zukav continues his personal experiences series by turning to a frequency of wisdom that has stayed close to his heart: Krishna. Drawing a familiar distinction between institutionalized religion and living spiritual truth, Gary makes clear this isn’t about Hinduism as dogma – it’s about the Soul’s intention pulsing at its center. He traces his encounter with the Mahabharata and its heart, the Bhagavad Gita, unpacking the epic allegory of two warring families as something far more intimate: the Great Battle between love and fear being fought within each of us, every moment.

Gary walks through the pivotal scene in which Arjuna – the greatest warrior in the Earth School – finds his physical body trembling before battle, and Krishna halts the chariot to provide a non-physical perspective. The two armies are not external families – they represent the loving and frightened parts of your own personality. The Responsible Choice of who drives your chariot is the choice that defines your life and creates your future.

Authentic Power is not found in armies, wealth, or external power – it is found in the alignment of your personality with your Soul, choosing love over fear, moment by moment, in the Earth School.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

  • (00:00) — Two Worlds, One Choice: Gary opens with the invitation anchoring this series: the choice between the new multisensory consciousness – gratitude, patience, and awe – and the old world of external power defined by anger, worry, and despair.
  • (03:05) — The Heart of Hinduism: Gary shares how the Mahabharata opened him to living spiritual wisdom –  and how its heart, the Bhagavad Gita, distills everything into one searing question: love or fear?
  • (06:30) — Arjuna’s Responsible Choice: The greatest warrior in the Earth School chooses Krishna as his chariot driver over all the armies in the world. Gary unpacks what that choice means – and why the Kaurava leader’s delight in gaining the armies (external power) is itself the lesson.
  • (09:44) — The Greatest Battle Is Inside You: The two warring families represent the loving and frightened parts of your personality. The battle between them is the curriculum every awakening human being is living right now.
  • (13:06) — Authentic Power Requires Your Total Involvement: Multisensory perception alone does not create Authentic Power – commitment, courage, compassion, and conscious action do. You cannot opt out. You volunteered.
  • (20:56) — Living it Consciously: Gary shares how he and Linda Francis listened to the Bhagavad Gita together in Spiritual Partnership, and how even after her Soul’s transition, they continue to co-create. He carries Krishna’s words not as philosophy, but as lived experience.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

Think of the great battle in your own life – not on any battlefield, but in a choice you keep deferring, a frightened part of yourself you keep handing the reins to. Arjuna, the greatest warrior in the world, froze. And yet he chose Krishna. Who are you choosing as your chariot driver? What would it look like, just today, to let love drive?

name: Soul Snack #79: Distractions Are Not the Enemy – They’re the Signal
short-description: Learn how to connect with your intuition every day.
blog-single-description: Learn how to connect with your intuition every day.
blog-rich-text:
Learn how to connect with your intuition every day. Click here to start your journey to authentic power!

A new consciousness is emerging, and with it comes a deeper look at the subtle forces that shape our inner lives. In this Soul Snack, Gary Zukav explores the nature of distractions – the impulses, temptations, and obsessions that pull us away from our spiritual growth. With clarity and compassion, he explains that:

The universe continually offers us opportunities to see the parts of our personality that limit our potential, not to punish us, but to strengthen our ability to choose love over fear.

Gary Zukav goes deeper by showing how distractions arise from frightened parts of the personality that prefer avoidance over self-awareness. These parts can appear powerful – whether through cravings, emotional attachments, or obsessive thoughts – but their influence depends entirely on whether we act on them. Distraction, then, is not an external force but an internal signal inviting us to remain present, aware, and willing to choose differently.

The solution is simple and time-honored: notice the distraction, feel it fully, and choose not to act on it. Each time you refrain from acting on a fear-based impulse, you loosen its grip and strengthen the loving, soul-aligned parts of your personality.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Snack:

(00:40) — Why distractions appear on the spiritual path: Gary Zukav explains how the universe uses distraction to reveal the frightened parts of your personality that limit your growth. 

(01:05) — How temptation pulls you away from self-awareness:Whether it’s craving, obsession, or fixation on another person, these impulses arise from frightened parts trying to avoid inner work. 

(02:08) — The power of choosing not to act from fear and to consciously choose to act from love: Gary Zukav shows why every distracted impulse grows stronger when acted upon – and weaker when you refrain. This is where authentic power begins. 

(02:28) — Why Responsible Choice rests with you:The universe can guide, but cannot choose for you. Only you can decide whether you react from fear or to consciously respond with love.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

This week, notice moments when temptation, craving, or fixation pulls your attention away from your inner work. Pause before reacting. Feel the distraction without judgment and ask yourself: Is this coming from a frightened part of my personality? Then choose not to act on it. Each time you make this choice, you reclaim your power, cultivate clarity, and strengthen the parts of you aligned with love.

name: Soul Feast #79: Buddha, Angels & the Moment My Mind Went Quiet – Gary Zukav’s Personal Experiences
short-description: Discover a new way of seeing and experiencing the world.
blog-single-description: Discover a new way of seeing and experiencing the world.
blog-rich-text:

In thisSoul Feast, Gary Zukav continues his personal experiences series by tuning to a frequency he never anticipated: Buddha. Making the same distinction he drew with Christ and Christianity, Gary is clear this isn’t about institutionalized structures – it’s about Siddhartha’s living wisdom. He shares two unexpected encounters in San Francisco – the Kalachakra initiation with Kalu Rinpoche and the Black Hat Ceremony with the Karmapa – that silenced the chatter of his personality and brought tears his five-sensory perception couldn’t explain.

Gary traces the parallels between Buddha and Christ – two Souls, two transformations, two Responsible Choices that changed everything – alongside the teaching from Genesis, his long-term non-physical teacher, that the Universe is inside you, and there is no outside. 

At first incomprehensible to the intellect, the idea echoed across traditions: Christ’s “the kingdom of heaven is within,” Lakota wisdom, and Buddha’s vision of worlds as numerous as dust motes. The intellect will never perceive this, Gary says. But your Soul can.

What emerged was simple: consciousness is immortal, and every moment in the Earth School is an invitation to make the Responsible Choice to choose love over fear.

What You’ll Discover in ThisSoul Feast:

  • (00:00) — Two Worlds, One Choice: Gary opens with the invitation anchoring this series: the choice between the new multisensory consciousness – gratitude, patience, and awe — and the old world of external power defined by anger, worry, and despair.
  • (03:05) — The Most Personal Are the Most Universal: Gary explains why he shares his own experiences – not to be believed, but because the most intimate truths are the ones your Soul already recognizes.
  • (06:30) — Two Encounters, One Silence: Gary recounts the Kalachakra initiation and the Black Hat Ceremony – experiences that stilled the chatter of his personality, brought unexplained tears, and drew the living wisdom of the Buddha into his life without his seeking it.
  • (13:19) — Buddha and Christ: Two Paths, One Transformation: Gary draws the parallels between Siddhartha and Jesus – two Souls, both transformed. It was their Responsible Choices in those moments, not their miracles, that made them who they became in the Earth School.
  • (18:21) — The Universe Is Inside You: Gary shares the teaching from Genesis that stopped him cold – and how it echoed across Christ, Lakota wisdom, and Buddha’s vision of worlds as numerous as dust motes, until it became undeniable to his multisensory perception.
  • (23:33) — You Are a Unique Expression of the Universe: When his non-physical teachers told Gary he was Immortal, something shifted permanently. Consciousness does not cease. Spiritual responsibility does not cease. And that realization makes every moment in the Earth School precious.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

Think of a moment when something unexpected opened a door – a conversation, an event you nearly didn’t attend. Did it quiet something in you? Leave a mark you couldn’t explain? Buddha didn’t find enlightenment by staying in the palace. Jesus didn’t become the Christ by avoiding the wilderness. What are you being asked to step toward that your intellect says makes no sense? What wisdom is already inside you, waiting to be recognized?
